from collections import defaultdict
import heapq

N = int(input())

A = list(map(int, input().split()))
B = list(map(int, input().split()))
X = list(map(int, input().split()))

G = defaultdict(list)
for i in range(1, N):
    G[i].append((i+1, A[i-1]))
    G[i].append((X[i-1], B[i-1]))

dist = [float('inf')] * (N+1)
dist[1] = 0
q = [(0, 1)]
heapq.heapify(q)
while len(q) > 0:
    v = heapq.heappop(q)[1]
    for next in G[v]:
        if dist[next[0]] > dist[v] + next[1]:
            dist[next[0]] = dist[v] + next[1]
            heapq.heappush(q, (dist[next[0]], next[0]))
print(dist[N])
